subject.title: fix(codex): normalize raw plugin payloads in dynamic tool bridge (fixes #97913) (AI-assisted)

question: Which open raw-payload normalization branch should be the canonical landing path after the serialization, final-result normalization, and real-proof blockers are addressed?
rationale: There are two open candidate PRs for the same canonical issue, and automation cannot safely choose a branch while this PR has blocking review findings and both branches still need maintainer-visible proof/CI review.

options.title: Repair this branch
options.body: Keep this PR as the candidate only if it normalizes the final post-extension result, uses total payload serialization, adds non-JSON regression coverage, and includes accessible real app-server/plugin proof.

options.title: Consolidate on the sibling
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97916 as the landing candidate if maintainers prefer its broader normalization shape after it is made clean and proof-reviewable.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Hold both PRs until a maintainer specifies the exact bridge-boundary contract and proof requirement.
